fields.name: protectedBranches
fields.description: JSON text of the protected branch names.

fields.name: docsPath
fields.description: Folder the factory writes docs to.

fields.name: ghUser
fields.description: GitHub login of the gh CLI account the factory uses (never a token).

fields.name: active
fields.description: 1 if the factory is active, else 0.

fields.name: agentModels
fields.description: JSON text of the per-stage agent models (stage to opus, sonnet, haiku or fable).

fields.name: github
fields.description: JSON text of the GitHub settings; empty = no GitHub.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Row version; bumped on every update.

fields.name: writeId
fields.description: Id of the write that produced this version.
